# GAPS — symfony-demo audit

**GENERATED by `tools/audit/rank.php`. Do not edit.**
Evidence is under `docs/audit/data/` and `docs/audit/probes/`; the severity,
depth and ownership calls are in `docs/audit/findings.tsv`. `rank.php --check`
regenerates this file and fails on any difference, so nothing here is a claim
without a file behind it.

## Severity classes

| class | meaning |
|---|---|
| S0 | **silent wrong answer** — compiles, links, runs, answers differently than php. Ranked above everything because it poisons every other measurement: a green build is actively misleading. |
| S1 | runtime hard failure — crash, uncaught throw, or a `return 0` link-stub that explodes later |
| S2 | compile or link hard failure, or a compiler crash |
| S3 | static finding with no observed runtime effect |
| S4 | advisory / analyzer residue |

**24 findings**: 1 S0, 6 S1, 13 S2, 2 S3, 2 S4.

Capability probes: 9 COMPILE, 1 CRASH, 9 DIFF, 7 PASS (`docs/audit/data/capability.tsv`).

## Closed

Kept rather than deleted: a row that vanishes is indistinguishable from
one that was never written. Each carries the probe that now gates it —
the promotion rule from `README.md` moves a probe into `tests/aot/cases/`
in the same commit that closes its gap.

| id | epic | now gated by | what it was |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ffi-alias-capture-ret` | `bare-alias-capture` | `tests/aot/cases/cap_str_capture_family.php` | strstr/strchr/strrchr resolved to the raw C bindings and returned a pointer where PHP returns a string — global PHP-semantics implementations now win at resolveCallName |
| `ffi-alias-capture-nul` | `bare-alias-capture` | `tests/aot/cases/cap_str_capture_family.php` | strcmp/strncmp/strcasecmp/strncasecmp compared NUL-terminated, so strcmp("a\0b","a\0c") answered 0 — now length-aware, unsigned, with PHP's prefix rule |
| `empty-array-byref-elem-repr` | `element-repr` | `tests/aot/cases/cap_callback_byref_capture.php` | an erased local passed to a by-ref callee that appends a foreign kind stayed vec[unknown] — collectByRefWidenArgs skipped UNKNOWN, deferring to an INTRA-procedural scan that cannot see the callee's store |
| `erased-byref-closure-capture` | `element-repr` | `tests/aot/cases/cap_array_recursion.php` | the widen scan walked CALL args only, so a `use (&$erased)` capture was an invisible by-ref writer; it now walks Closure_ captures too, and an append whose provenance is not visible at the site (a closure own param, supplied by the invoker) widens an erased element rather than being given the benefit of the doubt |
| `preg-named-groups` | `regex-surface` | `tests/aot/cases/cap_preg_named_groups.php` | no named group ever reached $matches in preg_match or preg_match_all — PCRE2's name table was never read; pcre2_pattern_info is now bound and the name is interleaved ahead of its number, as php does |
| `preg-offset-capture-pair` | `regex-surface` | `tests/aot/cases/cap_preg_named_groups.php` | preg_match ignored $flags entirely; PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE and PREG_UNMATCHED_AS_NULL now behave (preg_match_all already handled OFFSET_CAPTURE — the original finding conflated the two functions) |
| `union-nullable-loses-class` | `type-lowering` | `tests/aot/cases/cap_union_nullable_class.php` | lowerTypeHint sent every hint containing `|` to a cell, so the union spelling of a nullable (`S|null`, identical to `?S` in php) lost its class — the static type became bare `object` and every dispatch keyed on it misfired. Not prelude-specific: prelude/reflection.php just happens to spell all four optional returns that way |
| `shutdown-order-and-args` | `lifecycle` | `tests/aot/cases/cap_destruct_and_shutdown.php` | the queue ran only from an atexit hook, so it fired AFTER main returned and after every trailing release had run its destructors; and register_shutdown_function dropped its ...$args, so a callback parameter read an unbound slot |
| `array-walk-recursive-callback` | `element-repr` | `tests/aot/cases/cap_array_recursion.php` | array_walk_recursive handed its callback values that read back as raw bits — a witness of erased-byref-closure-capture, closed with it; array_push into an erased local was the same bug and is closed too |
| `parser-xor-operator` | `parser-gaps` | `tests/aot/cases/word_operators.php` | closed on main by cf74105 (`and`/`or`/`xor`), not by this branch — re-verified byte-exact after the merge |

## By owning epic

The ladder tier is the implementation order: a tier's dependency closure
lies entirely in lower tiers, so a gap first seen at tier N blocks tiers
N..8 and nothing below.

### `error-handling` — 1 finding(s), first bites at T1

- **S0** `function-exists-lies` — FIXED-PARTIAL: function_exists answered false for 44 of 53 common PHP functions — every codegen builtin and every compiler-rewritten name. trigger_error was never absent, it works and is rewritten to __mc_trigger_error; the probe measured PRESENCE and I recorded the wrong thing. Now 10 remain: emitBuiltin-only names (var_dump, print_r, floor, sqrt, debug_backtrace — isCodegenBuiltin is a strict subset of the emit dispatch) and demand-gated prelude names never called by the program (error_reporting, register_shutdown_function, ob_get_clean)

### `language-core` — 1 finding(s), first bites at T1

- **S1** `func-args-absent` — func_num_args/func_get_arg absent; symfony/console alone calls func_num_args 15 times to detect omitted arguments

### `iteration` — 1 finding(s), first bites at T2

- **S1** `iterator-double-foreach-sigbus` — two foreach loops over one IteratorAggregate SIGBUS

### `sapi-layer` — 4 finding(s), first bites at T3

- **S1** `superglobals-unseeded` — $_GET/$_POST/$_COOKIE/$_FILES/$_REQUEST are always []; $_SERVER carries a CLI shape with no web keys
- **S1** `sapi-fns-absent` — header/headers_sent/http_response_code/setcookie/ob_*/session_* all absent
- **S1** `putenv-absent` — putenv absent, so SHELL_VERBOSITY never round-trips through getenv
- **S2** `globals-whole-array` — a whole-array $GLOBALS read is a hard compile error

### `include-semantics` — 1 finding(s), first bites at T4

- **S1** `include-returns-null` — require/include lower to null, so config/bundles.php, config/*.php closures and the dumped DI container never load

### `parser-gaps` — 5 finding(s), first bites at T1

- **S2** `parser-ref-in-array-literal` — `[&$a[$k], $v]` (reference inside an array literal) is not parsed
- **S2** `parser-byref-arrow-fn` — `fn &() => ...` (by-reference arrow function) is not parsed
- **S2** `parser-high-byte-identifier` — an identifier containing bytes >= 0x80 is rejected; symfony/cache declares `class \xa9`
- **S2** `parser-reserved-enum-case` — an enum case named with a reserved word (`case ARRAY = 'array';`) is not parsed
- **S2** `parser-const-gaps` — `expected const name` / `expected ';' after const` in doctrine/dbal Types and nette/utils Image

### `spl-classes` — 1 finding(s), first bites at T1

- **S2** `spl-classes-absent` — PARTIAL: the 10 missing SPL EXCEPTIONS are declared with php parentage (BadMethodCall/Domain/Length/BadFunctionCall under LogicException; OutOfBounds/Overflow/Range/Underflow/UnexpectedValue under RuntimeException; JsonException under Exception). Still absent: the SPL ITERATORS and DirectoryIterator/DOMDocument/ReflectionExtension

### `reflection-tier4` — 6 finding(s), first bites at T3

- **S2** `refl-param-attributes` — ReflectionParameter::getAttributes absent; DI autowiring and controller argument resolution cannot work
- **S2** `refl-param-default` — ReflectionParameter::getDefaultValue/getDeclaringClass absent
- **S2** `refl-union-type` — no ReflectionUnionType / ReflectionIntersectionType
- **S2** `refl-enum-absent` — ReflectionEnum absent; doctrine enum types and form choices need it
- **S2** `refl-hydration` — newInstanceWithoutConstructor absent; doctrine hydration and var-exporter need it
- **S3** `refl-attr-is-instanceof` — ReflectionAttribute::IS_INSTANCEOF is declared but the filter matches exact names only

### `pdo-sqlite` — 1 finding(s), first bites at T6

- **S2** `pdo-absent` — no PDO, PDOStatement, PDOException or sqlite binding exists at all

### `autoload-semantics` — 1 finding(s), first bites at T1

- **S3** `autoload-queue-never-drained` — PARTIAL: spl_autoload_register/unregister/functions now exist (prelude/autoload.php), so composer ClassLoader::register() compiles and registers instead of being a hard compile error. class_exists($n, true) still does not DRAIN the queue: the lookup is an emit-time fold into a static table and the guard machinery depends on it staying constant-foldable, so firing it is a design call. Bounded impact — ahead of time an autoloader can never define a class, so only the callback side effects are lost

### `analyzer` — 1 finding(s), first bites at T1

- **S4** `analyzer-use-function` — the analyzer does not model `use function Ns\name` imports; 10 sites, code compiles and runs

### `regex-surface` — 1 finding(s), first bites at T2

- **S4** `preg-match-cell-boxing-cost` — preg_match $matches had to become cell-element so PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE can hold its [text,offset] pairs; measured 0.088s -> 0.102s (+16%) on a 300k-iteration match loop. Recoverable by specializing on a constant $flags argument, which is compiler work, not stdlib work
